artDirection: Paper Garden — cozy felt quiet-book puppet craft

concepts.prompt: A straight-on preschool tablet game screen showing a sky-blue wool-felt quiet-book page with layered rolling green felt hills and stitched flowers around the edges. Four large tactile activity cards fill the middle in one row: a cobalt denim zipper card, a leaf-green felt button card, a lavender metal snap card, and an orange fuzzy hook-and-loop tab card. A wide empty cream felt title plaque sits above and a wide empty orange felt play plaque sits below. Premium handmade quiet-book craft made entirely from real wool felt, woven denim, chunky cream blanket stitching, fuzzy hook-and-loop, and brushed metal fasteners. Rounded safe forms, soft studio lighting, shallow physical shadows, deep navy cobalt orange leaf green lavender cream and sunflower palette, coherent single visual system, polished preschool app composition. No vector, no flat graphic design, no text, no letters, no words, no logo, no watermark.
